shortDescription: NVS Class 6 (JNVST) Online Form 2027-28 last date today (extended). Apply free for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya admission; exam expected Nov 2026.
content:
Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) has opened online applications for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) Class 6 Admission Session 2027-28.

Eligible Class 5 students can apply for admission to JNVs. The last date has been extended (reports indicate extension up to 10 August 2026 with a correction window thereafter). The entrance exam is typically scheduled in November 2026 (e.g. 28 Nov 2026 as per notices).

Key points

  • Session: 2027-28
  • Class: VI
  • Application fee: usually free
  • Apply only on official NVS / CBSE portal

Parents should verify district eligibility, rural/urban category and age criteria from the official prospectus before final submission.
